name: HeroVideoDialog
description: A poster thumbnail with a play button that opens a dialog with your video. No video is bundled and none is fetched until the dialog opens. Focus moves into the dialog and returns to the thumbnail on close; Escape closes.

videoSrc.description: URL of the video file you supply. It loads only after the dialog opens.

title.description: Name of the video. It names the thumbnail button and the dialog.

poster.description: The thumbnail: an image URL string, or any element such as an img or a gradient.

tracks.description: track elements for captions and descriptions, placed inside the video.

isStill.description: Turns off the hover zoom of the thumbnail.

keyboard: Enter or Space: opens the video dialog
Escape: closes it and returns focus to the thumbnail
Tab: moves between the video controls and the Close button
requirements: The thumbnail is a real button named Play video: followed by the title, and opens a modal dialog with the same title
The poster image is decoration (alt empty): the button name carries the meaning
The dialog traps focus, closes with Escape or the Close button, and returns focus to the thumbnail
The video has native controls and does not start by itself loudly: it begins when the visitor opens it, and they can pause it
Supply captions through tracks; a video without captions fails WCAG 1.2.2
Nothing is loaded from videoSrc until the dialog opens; the hover zoom is off for reduced motion and isStill
screenReader: Button: Play video: title. Dialog: title, video controls, Close button

use_when: A product demo on a landing page
A tutorial the visitor chooses to watch
avoid_when: Video that must be visible without an action
anti_patterns: Autoplaying with sound on page load
